newsitem.title: BRAZIL: China soymeal purchases not confirmed - Brazil trade.
newsitem.headline: China soymeal purchases not confirmed - Brazil trade.

text.p: Brazilian traders said there was no confirmation of a rumour circulating in the Chicago market that China had bought around 150,000 tonnes of Brazilian soymeal in the last two days.
But one trader said China had bought 250,000 tonnes of soymeal from the U.S.
"China bought from the Gulf," he said. "It was 250,000 tonnes but I don't know the price."
"There is a rumour going around that China bought between 100,000 and 250,000 tonnes from Brazil in the last two days," said another trader. "But we don't have confirmation of that."
He added that he believed China may have been enquiring about Brazilian soymeal in order to bring down the price of U.S. soymeal with the intention of buying from the U.S.
A third trader said he had heard nothing about any China purchases, either of Brazilian or U.S. soymeal.
